items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: we had a group called the Little Ramblers, of which I had Bill Moore... And we had Adrian Rillenny, of course, on bass.

ctx.x: Well, you know, we, when Nichols, Jimmy Dorsey, and Tommy Dorsey joined the Ramblers, we had a group called the Little Ramblers, of which I had Bill Moore, known as Jazz Moore, on trumpet. And we had Adrian Rillenny, of course, on bass. We used no trombone. Stan King was on drums. We had Jimmy Dorsey on saxophone. That was the first Little Ramblers. And, of course, when Reds and Red Nickel and our trombone, Tommy Dorsey joined, why we put them in, and, of course, we really began to get some real sound.
This is, in a sense, a big step in sophistication after the jazz band, New Orleans jazz band, wasn't it?
